notes.title: FPS Chess - Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Balancing[/h2]

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: FPS Chess - Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[list]
[*] You can now make custom boards and use shiny pieces in local splitscreen matches.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where rook could cancel firing delay to spam shots.
[*] Fixed issue where custom chessboards lose password protection.
[*] Fixed pawn promotion not taking input from controller in local multiplayer.
[*] Improved stability of pawn promotion.
[*] Shiny pawn sword no longer sometimes does more damage than intended.
[*] Improved shiny king's blocking.
[*] Animation playrate fixes for swinging.
[*] Lighting and model optimizations for better performance across all machines.
[/list]

notes.title: FPS Chess - Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hi all,

We're very happy to inform you all that the new shiny pieces are now out of beta!  Shiny pieces are new variants of the classic six with new weapons and abilities! You can try them out in game now!  There are some changes made based on feedback from the beta as well.  Read below for info on this fairly beefy update!

[b][h2]New Content[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*]Just in case you missed it from the beta announcement, you can add shiny pieces individually in the board editor, or replace all the pieces with their shiny version at once in the host menu!
[/list]

[b][h2]Game Balancing[/h2][/b]

[b]The following balance changes were made based on feedback from the beta.[/b]

[list]
[*]Slightly nerfed the Shiny knight's shoot damage and rapid-fire damage.
[*]The Shiny Rook's shoot damage has been buffed.
[*]The Shiny Pawn's sword throw is now instant.
[*]Slightly nerfed the Shiny Pawn's swing damage.
[*]Removed the Shiny Queen's damage falloff.
[*]Nerfed the Shiny King's helicopter damage.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[b]The following bug fixes have been carried over from the beta.[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed soft lock where both players couldn't take their turn.
[*]Fixed soft lock where player joining a game couldn't promote their pieces.
[*]Fixed bug where player joining a game could hover multiple pieces simultaneously.
[/list]

[b]The following are new fixes from the beta.[/b]

[list]
[*]Shiny pawns no longer promote to regular pieces.
[*]Fixed a bug where after hosting a match with shiny pieces or a custom board, the next game would use the same board instead of the default board.
[*]The tutorial should now use the correct mouse sensitivity based on player settings.
[*]Fixed a bug where pieces destroyed  in combat would be invisible once play returned to "board mode".
[/list]

[h2][b]Upcoming Updates[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Adding the new shiny pieces to local multiplayer.
[*] Adding shiny ability gifs to the tutorial menu.
[*] Performance updates are being worked on (one thing specifically, reducing the polycount on the pieces themselves).
[/list]

[h2][b]Note From Developers[/b][/h2]

Thank you to everyone posting balance feedback for the new pieces! Keep it up, balance changes will continue to come.

notes.title: FPS Chess Version 1.1.0 Open Beta
notes.content:
Hello all!

We're happy to announce that we now have an open beta for the next update that you can now opt-into on Steam!  We're wanting to make sure there are as few bugs and oddities as possible with this update, so we're putting this into an open beta for you all to try out and provide feedback on!  See anything that you think we should know about?  Post them to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2021910/discussions/]Steam forums![/url]

The beta name is "[b]shiny-pieces-open-beta[/b]" with the password "[b]ShinyPiecesOpenBeta[/b]".  The beta will not show up for you to join unless you enter this password.

Not sure how to opt into a beta on Steam?  [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/5A86-0DF4-C59E-8C4A]Check out this guide![/url]  Just substitute "CS:GO" for "FPS Chess" where appropriate.

Please note that if you are playing in the beta, you will not be able to play with those who are using the default version of the game and vis versa.

So what does this beta contain?  Keeping reading below!

[h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]Introducing shiny pieces!  Shiny pieces are new variants of the classic six with new weapons and abilities!  Try them out now!
[*]You can add shiny pieces individually in the board editor, or replace all the pieces with their shiny version at once in the host menu!
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed soft lock where both players couldn't take their turn.
[*]Fixed soft lock where player joining a game couldn't promote their pieces.
[*]Fixed bug where player joining a game could hover multiple pieces simultaneously.
[/list]

[h2][b]Upcoming Updates[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]Adding the new shiny pieces to local multiplayer.
[*]Adding shiny ability gifs to the tutorial menu.
[*]Performance updates are being worked on (one thing specifically, reducing the polycount on the pieces themselves).
[/list]

[h2][b]Note From Developers[/b][/h2]

The developers behind this project wanted to express gratitude for the support you've all shown!  The students (now alumni!) also wanted to let you all know that they have all graduated and are working full time jobs now.  Updates may be irregular as they are supporting this game in their free time now, but there are still some planned updates to come.  Watch the space!
